# TASK-090 — specification

## Scope

SSO account rules shared by company SSO and Google (`sso-accounts.ts`): verified email required, returning users sign in, disabled accounts refused, invitations honoured and consumed, self-registration creates a disabled account awaiting an administrator, existing password emails are not linked; failures redirect to the sign-in page with an outcome instead of raw JSON. Fixes: Google sign-up no longer creates active accounts, company SSO honours the registration setting, and a disabled SSO user can no longer re-create an account.
